newsitem.title: JAPAN: NEC says raises optical fibre transmission volume.
newsitem.headline: NEC says raises optical fibre transmission volume.

text.p: NEC Corp said on Wednesday it had succeeded in experiments that expand the transmission capacity of optical fibres.
The new technology allows transmission of 2.6 terabits or 40 million phone lines worth of optical signals in one second, at a distance of 120 km without relay, NEC said in a statement.
"This is double the capacity of the former technology", an NEC spokesman said.
The technology can be used in transmission of 400,000 channels worth of visual information between households and cities, she said.
